reviewed_scope: Reviewed project additions across API translation, console and mobile ports, recompilation, software compatibility, decompilation and emulation; deduplicated repeated targets and retained primary source evidence. Includes source-backed metadata corrections for existing records. Includes nine additional source-backed status/summary/language corrections from the translation audit.

projects.title: D3D11On12 (Microsoft Direct3D 11-on-12 Mapping Layer)
projects.game: Direct3D 11 software using the Windows mapping layer
projects.status: Windows OS component. The project README describes a complete, relatively performant D3D11 driver implementation; applications opt in by creating a D3D11On12 device. Microsoft says source builds are for local testing and should not replace the OS version.
projects.summary: Maps Direct3D 11 user-mode driver commands to Direct3D 12. It is not a replacement d3d11.dll; applications select it through D3D11On12CreateDevice, with interop support for submitting work to both APIs.
projects.strategy: Direct3D 11 user-mode DDI mapping to Direct3D 12

sources.label: Microsoft project README: mapping method, usage, maturity, and compatibility limits

projects.title: D3D9On12 (Microsoft Direct3D 9-on-12 Mapping Layer)
projects.game: Direct3D 9 software using the Windows mapping layer
projects.status: Windows OS component. The project README describes a complete, relatively performant D3D9 driver implementation; applications opt in through Direct3DCreate9On12. Microsoft says source builds are for local testing and should not replace the OS version.
projects.summary: Maps Direct3D 9 user-mode driver commands to Direct3D 12. It is a D3D9 driver interface, not a replacement d3d9.dll; applications choose the D3D9On12 device through the documented creation APIs.
projects.strategy: Direct3D 9 user-mode DDI mapping to Direct3D 12

projects.title: D3D12 Translation Layer
projects.game: D3D11-style desktop graphics workloads using Direct3D 12
projects.status: The README documents it as the shared backend used by Microsoft’s D3D11On12 and D3D9On12 Windows components. It is developer integration infrastructure rather than a stand-alone Direct3D DLL; the public repository received changes on 2026-10-12.
projects.summary: A C++ helper library that implements D3D11-style graphics constructs and submits the resulting work to Direct3D 12. Microsoft documents it as the shared backend used by its D3D11On12 and D3D9On12 mapping layers.
projects.strategy: Higher-level graphics command translation to Direct3D 12

projects.title: OpenCLOn12
projects.status: Experimental and not certified conformant. The README says the OpenCL 1.2 API is fully implemented, but the project has not passed all conformance tests on a single underlying implementation.
projects.summary: Microsoft's mapping layer implements the OpenCL 1.2 API on top of Direct3D 12 and can load through an existing OpenCL ICD loader. It is also distributed as part of Microsoft's Universal D3D Mapping Layers package.

projects.title: vkd3d (Wine upstream)
projects.status: Active upstream project; WineHQ announced vkd3d 2.1 on 2026-08-24. The release announcement identifies it as a Direct3D-to-Vulkan graphics library; feature coverage should be read from each release rather than treated as complete D3D12 conformance.
projects.summary: Wine's upstream Direct3D 12 implementation translates the graphics API to Vulkan for Windows applications running through Wine. This is the upstream library, separate from the already cataloged VKD3D-Proton gaming fork.
projects.strategy: Direct3D 12 graphics API translation to Vulkan
